name: file.exists
description: Check whether a path exists; if so, report its type. Tolerates files and directories. Cheaper than file.stat when only existence + type matters.

exists.description: True iff the path resolves on the filesystem.

type.description: `absent` when `exists: false`; otherwise `file` / `directory` / `link` (reparse point) / `other` (device, pipe, socket).

flags.description: Win32 FILE_ATTRIBUTE_* flags currently set. Empty array when `exists: false` (no flags meaningful for absent paths). Per issue #93.

x-implementations.name: get_file_attributes
x-implementations.description: Win32 `GetFileAttributesW`. Returns INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES if the path doesn't exist (mapped to `exists: false, type: absent`); otherwise the attribute bitmask determines the type.

windows-modern.description: GetFileAttributesW. Reparse-point detection via FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT → `link`. ERR permission_denied when ACL denies the read; ERR not_found becomes `exists: false, type: absent` rather than an error (the verb's purpose is the existence check itself). Long paths via `\\?\` prefix automatic.

windows-classic.description: GetFileAttributesW on NT 5+; GetFileAttributesA on NT 4 / 9x. Reparse points are NT 5+ — classic on NT 4 / 9x reports `file` or `directory` only.
